chunks: Alas the woe for you, alas!

key_terms.أَوْلَىٰ: Woe, destruction, or first/most deserving of punishment
key_terms.فَأَوْلَىٰ: Then woe, or then destruction (emphatic repetition)

ai.seo_question: What does the phrase 'Awwa laka fa-awwa' mean in the context of Surah Al-Qiyamah?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, the repetition of 'awla' (woe) is interpreted as a double emphasis on the severity and immediacy of the punishment for those who deny the Resurrection, particularly highlighting the arrogance of the disbelievers. This phrase serves as a stern warning to the Quraysh, underscoring that their rejection of divine signs warrants a punishment that is not only severe but also inescapable and definitive.
